test_zone_search_draw_zone.title: A zone can be drawn on a camera's search canvas

steps.action: On Search, pick the Zone category and open the zone drawing for the configured camera.
steps.expected: The drawing canvas shows with a width and a height above zero.

steps.action: Draw a rectangle on the canvas.
steps.expected: The Done button becomes enabled.

steps.action: Click Done.
steps.expected: The zone is accepted.

test_zone_search_returns_results.title: Verify Zone search returns results after drawing and searching

steps.action: Open Search, choose the Zone category, open the drawing view for the configured camera, draw a zone and click Done.
steps.expected: The zone is accepted and the search filters are shown again.

steps.action: Pick a duration and click Search.
steps.expected: At least one Zone result appears in the result grid.

test_zone_search_play_result.title: Verify a Zone search result plays to its end

steps.action: On Search, pick the Zone category, open the zone drawing for the configured camera, draw a zone and click Done.
steps.expected: The zone is accepted.

steps.action: Pick a duration and search.
steps.expected: Results are listed.

steps.action: Play the first result.
steps.expected: The clip plays and the Replay icon shows when it ends.

test_line_search_draw_line.title: Verify a line can be drawn on the canvas.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search > Line - Setup & Drawing
steps.expected: Line - Setup & Drawing page loads without errors

steps.action: Identify the Reset Search clears Line category selection to be deleted from the list
steps.expected: Reset Search clears Line category selection is visible and identifiable in the list

steps.action: Note the current count of items in the list
steps.expected: Current item count is recorded for later comparison

steps.action: Click the delete button or action for the target Reset Search clears Line category selection
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog or prompt appears

steps.action: Verify the confirmation dialog displays the correct item being deleted
steps.expected: Dialog shows the name or identifier of the Reset Search clears Line category selection

steps.action: Click Confirm/Yes/Delete to proceed with the deletion
steps.expected: Deletion is processed and a success message appears

steps.action: Verify the Reset Search clears Line category selection no longer appears in the list
steps.expected: Reset Search clears Line category selection is removed from the list view

steps.action: Verify the item count decreased by one
steps.expected: List count reflects the removal

steps.action: Refresh the page and confirm the deletion persisted
steps.expected: The deleted Reset Search clears Line category selection does not reappear after refresh

test_line_search_returns_results.title: Verify Line search returns results after drawing and searching

steps.action: Open Search, choose the Line category, open the drawing view for the configured camera, draw a line and click Done.
steps.expected: The line is accepted and the search filters are shown again.

steps.action: Pick a duration and click Search.
steps.expected: At least one Line result appears in the result grid.

test_line_search_play_result.title: A Line search result plays to its end

steps.action: On Search, pick the Line category, open the line drawing for the configured camera, draw a line and click Done.
steps.expected: The line is accepted.

steps.action: Pick a duration and search.
steps.expected: Results are listed.

steps.action: Play the first result.
steps.expected: The clip plays and the Replay icon shows when it ends.
